requirementAssessments.evidence: `moldea/context/billing.md` contains durable billing-dispute guidance. `moldea/moldea.yaml` globally registers it under `context`, binds it to `/src/billing.ts` symbol `refundWindowDays`, declares `/src/billing.ts` under `affectedBy`, and assigns the context to `agents.support.context`. The patch adds exactly these relationships, and deterministic-after reports valid inspection/validation with no failures.

The patch preserves the required opening `# Support agent` and `You are the `support` agent.` identity, then adds instructions to consult billing context for refund disputes and invoice questions, apply only supported rules, and escalate unsupported outcomes. Current workspace content matches the patch.
